title: FORCE: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Fine-Tuning via Value-Calibrated Warm-up and Self-Distillation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often constrained by the imitation ceiling imposed by sub-optimal data. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning can surpass this limit, it is notoriously sample inefficient. This challenge arises from two core issues: (1) catastrophic initial unlearning due to an unstable Q-function and (2) inefficient policy updates caused by low-quality exploration data, often forcing a reliance on costly human interventions. We introduce FORCE, a 3-stage framework that stabilizes fine-tuning by tackling both issues. FORCE first incorporates a Value-Calibrated Warm-Up phase, utilizing on-policy rollouts to mitigate the distributional shift of the Q-function. Subsequently, during the online stage, this calibrated Q-function acts as a filter for both the policy's own action proposals and expert data, ensuring only high-value actions are used for the policy update. We evaluate FORCE on various simulation and real-world tasks, and the result shows that FORCE achieves a 79% absolute improvement in success rates and outperform prior RL methods by 10%, while accelerating training by 32.5%. Critically, it mitigates the common success rate drop and achieves this robust performance without human intervention, marking a significant step towards deploying capable and autonomous robotic agents.
tldr: FORCE is a 3-stage framework for RL fine-tuning of VLA models that mitigates initial unlearning and inefficient exploration via value-calibrated warm-up and self-distillation, achieving significant performance gains in simulation and real-world tasks without human intervention.
tldr_zh: FORCE是一个三阶段框架，用于VLA模型的强化学习微调，通过值校准热身和自我蒸馏缓解初始遗忘和低效探索，在仿真和真实任务中取得显著性能提升且无需人工干预。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型常受限于次优数据所施加的模仿天花板。尽管强化学习（RL）微调能够超越这一限制，但其样本效率低下是公认的难题。这一挑战源于两个核心问题：（1）不稳定的Q函数导致初始训练阶段出现灾难性的知识遗忘；（2）低质量探索数据造成策略更新效率低下，往往迫使系统依赖昂贵的人工干预。我们提出FORCE框架，这是一个三阶段方案，通过同时解决这两个问题来稳定微调过程。FORCE首先引入价值校准预热阶段，利用当前策略的在线交互轨迹来缓解Q函数分布偏移。随后在在线阶段，经校准的Q函数既作为策略自身动作提议的筛选器，也用于过滤专家数据，确保仅采用高价值动作进行策略更新。我们在多种仿真和实际任务上评估了FORCE，结果表明FORCE实现了79%的成功率绝对提升，相较先前RL方法性能提升10%，同时训练速度加快32.5%。至关重要的是，该方法有效缓解了成功率的常见骤降问题，无需人工干预即实现稳健性能，这标志着向部署具备自主能力的高度智能机器人迈出了重要一步。

title: ROAD-VLA: Robust Online Adaptation via Self-Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Effective online adaptation of vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging, as sparse rewards provide weak supervision for high-dimensional autoregressive action policies. Although self-distillation can in principle provide denser training signals, we find that text-based privileged teachers conditioned on demonstrations, retrieved experiences, or high-level plans are ineffective for VLA adaptation, exposing a modality gap between symbolic guidance and low-level robot actions. We propose ROAD-VLA, an advantage-guided self-distillation framework that constructs a proximal teacher directly in action space by perturbing action-token logits with calibrated advantage estimates. This converts sparse rewards into dense token-level supervision while keeping the teacher close to the current policy. We further derive a policy-improvement lower bound under calibrated advantages and accurate teacher matching. Across seven robotic manipulation environments with in-distribution and out-of-distribution shifts, ROADVLA outperforms PPO in nearly all settings, demonstrating robust online VLA adaptation.
tldr: This paper introduces ROAD-VLA, an advantage-guided self-distillation framework that converts sparse rewards into dense token-level supervision for online adaptation of Vision-Language-Action models, outperforming PPO across robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ROAD-VLA，一种优势引导的自蒸馏框架，将稀疏奖励转换为密集的令牌级监督，用于视觉-语言-动作模型的在线适应，在机器人操作任务上优于PPO。
summary_zh:
**摘要**

视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的有效在线自适应仍然具有挑战性，因为稀疏奖励为高维自回归动作策略提供的监督信号较弱。尽管自蒸馏在原则上可以提供更密集的训练信号，但我们发现，基于专家演示、检索经验或高层规划的文本特权教师无法有效指导VLA自适应，这暴露了符号引导与低级机器人动作之间的模态差距。我们提出ROAD-VLA，一种优势引导的自蒸馏框架，通过使用校准的优势估计扰动动作令牌logits，直接在动作空间中构建一个贴近当前策略的近端教师。该方法将稀疏奖励转化为密集的令牌级监督，同时保持教师与当前策略接近。我们进一步推导了在校准优势与精确教师匹配下的策略改进下界。在七个包含分布内与分布外偏移的机器人操作环境中，ROAD-VLA几乎在所有设置下均优于PPO，展示了其稳健的在线VLA自适应能力。

title: ASSCG: Just-Right Gating over Chattering for Fast-Slow LLM Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can improve autonomous driving planning but are costly to query online, and existing fast-slow planners often rely on hand-designed triggering rules that either over-call the slow system or call it at the wrong times. We formulate slow-system invocation as a resource-aware sequential decision problem and propose the Adaptive Slow-System Control Gate (ASSCG), which makes frame-level Query/Cache/Drop decisions to refresh, reuse, or suppress slow guidance. ASSCG uses an RWKV backbone for efficient long-horizon gating and is trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO-style compute-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. We apply ASSCG to two different fast-slow architectures: (i) AsyncDriver on nuPlan Hard20 closed-loop evaluation, where ASSCG improves score to 67.28 (+2.28) while reducing average end-to-end inference latency by 60%; and (ii) a RecogDrive-based dual system that we build by replacing its original VLM-2B module with a lightweight ViT-based fast planner and adding an LLM slow planner, evaluated on NAVSIM, where ASSCG achieves 91.4 PDMS (+0.6) and increases average speed by 25%. The project page, including video visualizations and additional results, is available at https://williamxuanyu.github.io/asscg/.
tldr: ASSCG introduces an adaptive gating mechanism for fast-slow LLM planners in autonomous driving, deciding online when to query the slow system via a resource-aware sequential decision model trained with supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning, achieving significant latency reduction and performance gains on nuPlan and NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: ASSCG 提出了一种自适应门控机制，用于自动驾驶中的快慢 LLM 规划器，通过资源感知的顺序决策模型在线决定何时查询慢系统，并采用监督微调和强化学习微调训练，在 nuPlan 和 NAVSIM 上实现了显著的延迟降低和性能提升。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型能够提升自动驾驶规划能力，但实时查询成本高昂；现有的快慢双系统规划器通常依赖人工设计的触发规则，这往往导致过度调用慢系统或在错误时机调用。本文将慢系统调用形式化为资源感知的序贯决策问题，并提出自适应慢系统控制门（ASSCG），该机制在帧级别执行查询/缓存/丢弃决策，以更新、复用或抑制慢系统引导信号。ASSCG采用RWKV骨干网络实现高效长时序门控，并通过监督微调及后续基于GRPO风格的计算感知强化微调进行训练。我们将ASSCG应用于两种不同的快慢架构：（i）在nuPlan Hard20闭环评估中，基于AsyncDriver架构，ASSCG将评分提升至67.28（+2.28），同时将端到端平均推理延迟降低60%；（ii）基于RecogDrive构建的双系统架构中，我们将其原始VLM-2B模块替换为轻量级ViT快速规划器，并增加大语言模型慢规划器，在NAVSIM评测中，ASSCG实现91.4 PDMS（+0.6），平均速度提升25%。项目页面（含视频可视化及更多结果）详见：https://williamxuanyu.github.io/asscg/。

title: RigPI: Dynamic Parameter Identification of Rigid Body via VLM-Seeded Differentiable Simulation
summary: Accurate physical parameter identification of manipulated objects is fundamental to advanced robotic manipulation and the construction of faithful digital twins. However, acquiring physically consistent inertial and frictional properties from real-world interactions remains challenging due to sensing noise, modeling errors, and limited prior knowledge. This paper presents RigPI, a systematic framework for identifying dynamic parameters of both unconstrained rigid bodies and multi-link rigid bodies during robot-object interaction. RigPI integrates vision-based semantic priors, force-torque measurements, and motion observations within a differentiable simulation pipeline. A vision-language model (VLM) provides informed initialization and a constrained search space, while gradient information from a differentiable physics simulator enables efficient and stable parameter refinement. The proposed two-stage optimization strategy alleviates sensitivity to noise and avoids physically implausible solutions. Extensive real-world experiments on objects with revolute and prismatic joints demonstrate that RigPI achieves accurate and stable parameter estimates, and successfully reproduces manipulation trajectories on a real robot with parameter-aware predictive validity. These results highlight the effectiveness and robustness of RigPI for real-world robotic system identification tasks.
tldr: RigPI integrates VLM-based semantic priors with differentiable simulation to accurately identify dynamic parameters of rigid bodies for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: RigPI 结合 VLM 语义先验与可微仿真，为机器人操作实现刚体动力学参数的精确辨识。
summary_zh: 对受操作物体进行精确的物理参数识别是实现先进机器人操作和构建真实数字孪生的基础。然而，由于感知噪声、建模误差以及有限的先验知识，从真实世界交互中获取物理一致的惯性和摩擦特性仍具挑战性。本文提出RigPI——一个用于在机器人-物体交互过程中识别无约束刚体及多连杆刚体动力学参数的系统性框架。RigPI在可微仿真流程中集成了基于视觉的语义先验、力/力矩测量以及运动观测。视觉语言模型（VLM）提供有依据的初始化和受限搜索空间，而可微物理模拟器的梯度信息则能够实现高效且稳定的参数优化。所提出的两阶段优化策略减轻了对噪声的敏感性，并避免了物理上不可行的解。针对具有旋转关节和移动关节的物体开展的大量真实世界实验表明，RigPI能够获得精确且稳定的参数估计，并在真实机器人上成功复现具备参数感知预测有效性的操作轨迹。这些结果凸显了RigPI在真实世界机器人系统辨识任务中的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Memory Retrieval in Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Robot Control
summary: General-purpose robots operating in partially observable environments, such as homes, require memory to support autonomy. They must recall diverse information from the past, such as where objects were placed, which tasks a human partner has completed, and when an appliance was turned on. Achieving this versatility requires a general memory retrieval mechanism. Transformer architectures that use attention over long contexts for memory retrieval provide a promising approach, as they learn retrieval from data rather than relying on task-specific or hand-designed rules. However, directly incorporating them into imitation learning from offline data introduces two key challenges: (1) the policy may learn spurious correlations between past information and predicted actions, and (2) errors accumulate in memory due to prediction inaccuracies and their compounding interactions with the environment, causing model drift and cascading failures. To address both challenges, we introduce HALO, a visuomotor policy with an attention-based memory retrieval mechanism for long-horizon control. First, to suppress spurious correlations, HALO distills vision-language model (VLM) priors into the policy. It generates memory-dependent question--answer pairs from demonstration trajectories and trains jointly with a video question--answering objective, steering retrieval toward task-relevant information. Second, to reduce the impact of accumulated errors in memory during closed-loop control, HALO uses sparse attention that restricts retrieval to only the most relevant parts of the history. Together, these components enable more reliable long-horizon control by guiding the policy to retrieve task-relevant information from up to eight minutes of past experience. Project website: https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/HALO
tldr: HALO introduces an attention-based memory retrieval mechanism for visuomotor policies, addressing spurious correlations and memory drift by distilling VLM priors via QA objectives and using sparse attention for robust long-horizon robot control from up to eight minutes of history.
tldr_zh: HALO 提出了一种基于注意力机制的记忆检索方法，通过 VLM 蒸馏问答目标和稀疏注意力机制，解决了视触觉策略中的虚假相关性和记忆漂移问题，实现了长达八分钟的长周期机器人控制。
summary_zh: 在部分可观测环境（如家庭）中运行的通用机器人需要记忆来支持自主性。它们必须回忆过往的多样化信息，例如物品的放置位置、人类合作者已完成的任务，以及电器开启的时间。实现这种多功能性需要通用的记忆检索机制。利用Transformer架构对长上下文进行注意力记忆检索是一种有前景的方法，因为它能够从数据中学习检索，而非依赖特定任务或手工设计的规则。然而，将其直接融入基于离线数据的模仿学习会带来两个关键挑战：（1）策略可能学习到过往信息与预测动作之间的虚假相关性；（2）由于预测不准确性及其与环境交互时产生的复合效应，错误会在记忆中累积，导致模型漂移和级联故障。为解决这两个挑战，我们提出HALO——一种基于注意力记忆检索机制的视觉运动策略，用于长程控制。首先，为抑制虚假相关性，HALO将视觉语言模型（VLM）的先验知识蒸馏到策略中。它从演示轨迹中生成依赖于记忆的问答对，并结合视频问答目标进行联合训练，使检索导向任务相关信息。其次，为减少闭环控制中记忆累积错误的影响，HALO采用稀疏注意力机制，仅限制检索历史中最相关的部分。这些组件共同通过引导策略从长达八分钟的过往经验中检索任务相关信息，实现了更可靠的长程控制。项目网站：https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/HALO

title: Learning Action Priors for Cross-embodiment Robot Manipulation
summary: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models build on a Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone by attaching an action module and optimizing the full policy jointly. This design inherits strong visual and linguistic priors from the VLM, but leaves the action module to learn physical motion almost from scratch. As a result, the policy lacks an explicit motion prior, forcing early optimization to simultaneously discover temporal action dynamics and cross-modal alignment, a challenge further amplified in cross-embodiment settings. In this work, we propose to pretrain the action module with motion priors before cross-modal VLA alignment. Specifically, we introduce a two-stage training framework that equips the action module with cross-embodiment temporal motion structure before VLA training begins. In Stage~1, a lightweight flow-matching-based encoder-decoder action module efficiently learns temporal motion structure solely from unconditioned action trajectories, without processing visual or language tokens. In Stage~2, this learned prior is transferred to VLA training through decoder reuse and early-stage latent distillation, aligning visual-language features with the action embedding space while still allowing end-to-end policy refinement. In addition, the trained encoder serves as a compact history compressor, summarizing state-action histories into a single temporal context token for history-aware modeling at negligible cost. Extensive experiments across 13 diverse cross-embodiment tasks on both simulated and real-world platforms validate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with VLA training without action priors, our model achieves faster convergence, higher success rates, and substantially stronger performance on data-scarce real-world tasks. Moreover, scaling up the action data in Stage~1 yields a more generalizable action prior that directly improves downstream VLA performance.
tldr: Proposes a two-stage framework that pretrains action modules with motion priors (via flow-matching on unconditioned trajectories) before VLA alignment, significantly improving cross-embodiment manipulation performance and data efficiency.
tldr_zh: 提出一种两阶段训练框架，在VLA对齐之前先用动作先验（基于流匹配的无条件轨迹）预训练动作模块，显著提升跨本体操作性能和数据效率。
summary_zh: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）主干构建，通过附加动作模块并联合优化完整策略来实现。这种设计继承了VLM强大的视觉和语言先验，但导致动作模块几乎从零开始学习物理运动。因此，策略缺乏显式的运动先验，迫使早期优化同时探索时序动作动态与跨模态对齐——这一挑战在跨具身场景中尤为突出。本研究提出在跨模态VLA对齐之前，预先用运动先验训练动作模块。具体而言，我们引入两阶段训练框架，在VLA训练开始前赋予动作模块跨具身时序运动结构：第一阶段，基于轻量级流匹配的编码器-解码器动作模块仅从无条件动作轨迹中高效学习时序运动结构，无需处理视觉或语言标记；第二阶段，通过解码器复用和早期潜在蒸馏将习得先验迁移至VLA训练，在保持端到端策略优化的同时，对齐视觉-语言特征与动作嵌入空间。此外，训练后的编码器可作为紧凑的历史压缩器，将状态-动作历史汇总为单个时序上下文标记，以极低成本实现历史感知建模。在模拟和真实平台上的13项跨具身任务中进行的广泛实验验证了该方法的有效性。与无动作先验的VLA训练相比，本模型收敛更快、成功率更高，在数据稀缺的真实世界任务中表现显著增强。同时，扩大第一阶段动作数据规模可获得更通用的动作先验，直接提升下游VLA性能。

title: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
summary: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning robot manipulation policies. However, common sources of human demonstration data, such as motion-capture trajectories and internet videos, capture mostly motion and appearance while missing the contact forces that are critical for force-sensitive manipulation. In this paper, we introduce ForceBand, a low-cost wrist-worn sEMG system that turns human muscle activity into force-enriched demonstrations. We first collect a 10-hour multimodal dataset containing egocentric video, sEMG, IMU, and fingertip force measurements across diverse actions and objects. Using this dataset, we pre-train an EMG2Force model that predicts per-finger forces from sEMG and IMU signals. After a short user-specific calibration, users can collect target-task demonstrations using only ForceBand and video; EMG2Force then labels these demonstrations with per-finger force traces, producing force-augmented demonstrations for robot policy learning. Experiments show that ForceBand recovers fine-grained fingertip interactions with over 50% lower force prediction error than vision-based baselines and achieves an 87% success rate on pick, squeeze, and place tasks that require object-specific force control across objects with diverse shapes, sizes, and weights. Project website: https://forceband-emg.github.io
tldr: ForceBand introduces a low-cost wrist-worn sEMG system that predicts per-finger forces from muscle activity and IMU signals, enabling force-enriched human demonstrations for learning force-sensitive robot manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: ForceBand 提出了一种低成本腕戴式 sEMG 系统，通过肌肉活动和 IMU 信号预测每根手指的力，从而为学习力敏感型机器人操作策略提供富含力信息的人类演示。
summary_zh: 人类示教是学习机器人操作策略的一种可扩展数据来源。然而，常见的人类示教数据来源（如动作捕捉轨迹和互联网视频）主要捕捉运动与外观信息，而缺少对力敏感操作至关重要的接触力。本文介绍了ForceBand——一种低成本腕戴式表面肌电（sEMG）系统，能将人类肌肉活动转化为富含力信息的示教数据。我们首先采集了一个包含第一人称视频、sEMG、惯性测量单元（IMU）以及指尖力测量值的10小时多模态数据集，覆盖多种动作与物体。基于该数据集，我们预训练了一个EMG2Force模型，可从sEMG与IMU信号预测每根手指的受力。经过简短的个体化校准后，用户仅需使用ForceBand与视频即可采集目标任务示教数据；EMG2Force随后为这些示教数据标注每根手指的受力轨迹，生成用于机器人策略学习的力增强示教。实验表明，ForceBand能够恢复精细的指尖交互，相比基于视觉的基线方法，受力预测误差降低超过50%，并在需针对不同形状、尺寸和重量的物体进行特定力控制的抓取、挤压与放置任务中达到87%的成功率。项目网站：https://forceband-emg.github.io

title: TaskNPoint: How to Teach Your Humanoid to Hit a Backhand in Minutes
summary: How do we learn to hit a tennis backhand? Not from a thousand hours of tennis tournaments on TV - we work with a coach and practice. We argue this is also the right recipe for teaching dynamic skills to humanoid robots. This follows from a structural property of dynamic skills: the outcome is decided by a short, crucial portion of the trajectory - for a backhand, the ~20cm of racket travel around ball contact. Getting this interaction window right requires coordinating the whole motion, so that control, physics, and morphology act in concert. Learning thus reduces to mastering a handful of distinct actions and, for each, practicing until the window comes out right. To this end, we introduce TaskNPoint, a training protocol which makes the coach-learner division of labor explicit. The human coach contributes four inputs: a discrete set of skills (e.g. different shots), one demonstration per skill, identification of the interaction window, and the goal. Learning in a physically realistic simulation environment fills in each action trajectory and provides robustness to unmodeled events. Crucially, randomized target sampling during training lets a single demonstration generalize zero-shot to unseen goal locations. We test this approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid that hits forehands and backhands against balls thrown by a human, kicks incoming soccer balls, and picks and places boxes from novel locations. We find that learning is successful from short human video demonstrations and under an hour of training on a single GPU, with no per-task reward tuning.
tldr: TaskNPoint introduces a training protocol where a human coach provides discrete skills, one demonstration per skill, the interaction window, and the goal, enabling a humanoid robot to learn dynamic skills like tennis backhands from short video demonstrations and under an hour of GPU training with no reward tuning.
tldr_zh: TaskNPoint提出一种训练协议，由人类教练提供离散技能、每技能一次演示、交互窗口和目标，使人形机器人能从短视频演示和一小时内的GPU训练中学会网球反手等动态技能，无需奖励调整。
summary_zh: 我们如何学会打网球反手？并非通过观看电视上数千小时的网球比赛，而是与教练合作并反复练习。我们认为，这也是教人形机器人掌握动态技能的正确方法。这一观点源于动态技能的结构特性：结果由轨迹中一段短暂且关键的部分决定——以反手为例，即球拍在触球前后约20厘米的移动区间。要正确完成这一交互窗口，需要协调全身运动，使控制、物理和形态协同作用。因此，学习简化为掌握少数几种不同的动作，并针对每种动作反复练习，直到交互窗口达到理想状态。为此，我们引入TaskNPoint训练协议，明确划分教练与学习者的分工。人类教练提供四项输入：一组离散技能（如不同击球类型）、每项技能的一次示范、交互窗口的识别以及目标。在物理逼真的模拟环境中学习，可填充每个动作轨迹，并提供对未建模事件的鲁棒性。关键在于，训练中随机的目标采样使得单个示范能够零样本泛化至未见过的目标位置。我们在Unitree G1人形机器人上测试了该方法，使其击打人类抛出的正手球和反手球、踢飞来足球，以及从新位置拾取和放置箱子。实验表明，该方法仅需短时人类视频示范，在单块GPU上训练不到一小时即可成功学会技能，且无需为每项任务调整奖励函数。

title: Learning Robot Visual Navigation in Crowds via Intention-Aware Scene Representations
summary: Robot crowd navigation requires the ability to infer human intentions while accounting for the structural constraints of the environment. Currently, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) provides a promising method for learning navigation policies that understand human intentions. However, most of them rely on limited scene representations, treating pedestrians as simple 2D points and ignoring rich visual cues from both humans and the environment. To address this issue, we introduce iCrowdNav, a novel visual crowd navigation method with intention-aware scene representations, to encode behavioral and structural context from egocentric visual observations. Our method employs two key components: a spatio-temporal encoder for extracting occupancy features of the scene, and Intent-Interact Former (I$^2$ Former), an attention-based module that encodes human poses to infer pedestrians' motion intentions. These features are integrated into a compact state embedding that supports effective DRL policy training. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves superior performance over baselines, and real-world deployment demonstrates vision-based crowd navigation.
tldr: This paper introduces iCrowdNav, a visual crowd navigation method that uses an attention-based module (I² Former) to encode human poses for inferring motion intentions, combined with a spatio-temporal encoder for occupancy features, achieving superior performance in simulated and real-world robot navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出iCrowdNav，一种视觉人群导航方法，通过基于注意力的I² Former模块编码人体姿态来推断运动意图，并结合时空编码器提取占用特征，在仿真和真实机器人导航中取得了优越性能。
summary_zh: 机器人人群导航需要具备推断人类意图的能力，同时考虑环境的结构约束。目前，深度强化学习（DRL）为学习理解人类意图的导航策略提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，现有大多数方法依赖有限的场景表征，将行人视为简单的二维点，忽视了来自人类和环境的丰富视觉线索。为解决这一问题，我们提出iCrowdNav——一种新颖的、具有意图感知场景表征的视觉人群导航方法，用于从自我中心视觉观测中编码行为与结构上下文。该方法包含两个关键模块：提取场景占用特征的时空编码器，以及基于注意力机制的Intent-Interact Former（I² Former）模块，该模块通过编码人体姿态推断行人的运动意图。这些特征被整合为紧凑的状态嵌入表示，以支持高效的DRL策略训练。大量实验表明，我们的方法在性能上优于基准方法，且实际部署验证了基于视觉的人群导航能力。

title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
summary: We present RoboAtlas, a contextual Active SLAM framework that adaptively balances geometric exploration and semantic reasoning using a scalable 3D semantic mapping system, OpenRoboVox. RoboAtlas integrates frontier exploration, global semantic-map reasoning, and egocentric VLM-based reasoning through a contextual multi-armed bandit that transitions from exploration to semantically guided navigation as scene understanding improves. We evaluate the system in simulation and on a Unitree Go2 robot in large-scale real-world environments exceeding 1800 m2 with approx. 30k mapped semantic instances, achieving a 100% task success rate. On the GOAT-Bench "Val Unseen" benchmark, RoboAtlas achieves state-of-the-art performance with highest reported success rate (SR) of 90.6%, using GPT-4o, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 17.8 percentage points in SR. Using the much smaller Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, it still achieves 88.8% SR, outperforming all baselines using GPT-4o in SR, and revealing the importance of the information gained by our semantic mapping framework over simply replacing the underlying foundation model. The results demonstrate that grounding foundation models with large-scale 3D semantic maps enables robust and efficient contextual Active SLAM.
tldr: RoboAtlas integrates frontier exploration, global semantic-map reasoning, and egocentric VLM reasoning via a contextual multi-armed bandit to achieve active SLAM that balances geometric exploration with semantic navigation, achieving state-of-the-art results on GOAT-Bench and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: RoboAtlas 通过上下文多臂赌博机结合前沿探索、全局语义地图推理和第一人称 VLM 推理，实现了在几何探索与语义导航之间的自适应平衡，在 GOAT-Bench 上取得最先进结果，并在 Unitree Go2 机器人上成功部署。
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们提出RoboAtlas，一个上下文感知的主动SLAM框架，它通过可扩展的3D语义映射系统OpenRoboVox，自适应地平衡几何探索与语义推理。RoboAtlas融合了前沿探索、全局语义地图推理以及基于自我中心VLM的推理，通过一个上下文感知的多臂老虎机机制，随着场景理解的提升，从探索过渡到语义引导的导航。我们在仿真环境和一台宇树Go2机器人上，在超过1800平方米、包含约3万个已映射语义实例的大规模真实世界环境中评估该系统，实现了100%的任务成功率。在GOAT-Bench的"Val Unseen"基准测试中，RoboAtlas达到了当前最优性能，使用GPT-4o时报告的最高成功率（SR）为90.6%，比先前最强基线的成功率提高了17.8个百分点。使用更小的Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型时，它仍能达到88.8%的成功率，在成功率上优于所有使用GPT-4o的基线方法，这揭示了我们语义映射框架所获取信息的重要性，其作用远超简单替换底层基础模型。结果表明，将基础模型与大规模3D语义图相结合，能够实现稳健且高效的上下文感知主动SLAM。

title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
summary: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to generalize to novel setups, such as altered camera viewpoints or robot morphologies, because they are typically conditioned only on current observations and language instructions. By ignoring the underlying system configuration as a variable, these models implicitly assume a fixed execution context encountered during training, necessitating data-intensive fine-tuning for any new environment. In this work, we introduce In-Context World Modeling (ICWM), a framework that treats system identification as an in-context adaptation problem. ICWM enables robot policies to autonomously infer essential system variables from a short history of self-generated, task-agnostic interactions. Unlike traditional In-Context Learning that uses demonstrations to specify what task to perform, ICWM leverages the context window to understand how the system operates. By processing these interactions before task execution, the model implicitly captures the world dynamics of the current system, enabling adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world robot platforms demonstrate that ICWM significantly outperforms standard VLA baselines on novel camera viewpoints.
tldr: Proposes In-Context World Modeling (ICWM), which lets robot policies infer system dynamics from a short history of self-generated interactions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel camera viewpoints or morphologies without parameter updates.
tldr_zh: 提出上下文世界建模（ICWM），使机器人策略能从短暂的自生成交互历史中推断系统动态，在无需参数更新的情况下零样本适应新的相机视角或机器人形态。
summary_zh: 现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常难以泛化到新设置中（例如相机视角或机器人形态的改变），原因在于这些模型通常仅以当前观测和语言指令为条件。由于将底层系统配置作为变量忽略，此类模型隐含地假设了训练时所遇到的固定执行环境，从而需要为任何新环境进行数据密集型的微调。本文提出上下文世界建模（ICWM）框架，将系统辨识视为一种上下文自适应问题。ICWM使机器人策略能够从短期的、自主生成的、与任务无关的交互历史中自主推断关键的系统变量。与传统上下文学习利用示范来指定要执行的任务不同，ICWM利用上下文窗口来理解系统的运行方式。通过在执行任务前处理这些交互，模型隐式地捕获当前系统的世界动态，从而无需更新参数即可适应新配置。在仿真环境和真实机器人平台上进行的大量实验表明，ICWM在新型相机视角下显著优于标准VLA基线模型。

title: G2DP: Diffusion Planning with Spatio-Temporal Grid Guidance
summary: In autonomous driving, diffusion-based planners have emerged as a promising paradigm for robust motion planning in dense and interactive traffic, as they can effectively model diverse driving behaviors. However, their inherent stochasticity often requires explicit guidance during denoising to ensure safety and route adherence for robust closed-loop execution. Existing guidance typically relies on sparse, entity-centric geometric queries or post-hoc refinement, yielding limited situational awareness and fragile performance in interactive scenes. To address this issue, we propose G2DP (Grid-Guided Diffusion Planning), a diffusion-based planner that directly enforces dense environmental constraints through inference-time guidance. Specifically, G2DP constructs a differentiable spatio-temporal cost volume by fusing probabilistic future occupancy distributions with a route-progress map. By formulating this volume as a continuous safety energy functional, it injects dense gradients directly into the denoising loop, actively steering trajectory generation toward collision-free and progress-optimal regions. Extensive closed-loop evaluations show that G2DP achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuPlan, outperforming the strongest imitation-learning baseline by +7.2 points in reactive score. It further maintains top scores in zero-shot transfers to interPlan and DeepScenario benchmarks, with collision avoidance improving by +10.15 over the unguided approach on interPlan. These results demonstrate that spatio-temporal cost grids serve as an effective representation for robust guidance in diffusion-based planning.
tldr: Proposes G2DP, a diffusion-based planner for autonomous driving that uses a differentiable spatio-temporal cost volume to inject dense safety and route guidance directly into the denoising loop, achieving state-of-the-art closed-loop performance on nuPlan and zero-shot transfer to interPlan and DeepScenario.
tldr_zh: 提出G2DP，一种用于自动驾驶的扩散规划器，通过可微的时空代价体积将密集的安全与路线引导直接注入去噪循环，在nuPlan上实现闭环SOTA性能，并在interPlan和DeepScenario上零样本迁移。
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶领域，基于扩散的规划器已成为密集交互交通场景中实现鲁棒运动规划的一种有前景的范式，因其能够有效建模多样化的驾驶行为。然而，其固有的随机性通常需要在去噪过程中施加显式引导，以确保安全性和路线遵循，从而实现鲁棒的闭环执行。现有引导方法通常依赖于稀疏的、以实体为中心的几何查询或事后优化，导致场景感知能力有限，在交互场景中表现脆弱。为解决这一问题，我们提出G2DP（网格引导扩散规划），一种基于扩散的规划器，通过推理时引导直接施加密集的环境约束。具体而言，G2DP通过将概率性的未来占据分布与路线进度图融合，构建可微分的时空代价体。通过将该代价体表述为连续的安全能量泛函，它能将密集梯度直接注入去噪循环，主动引导轨迹生成朝向无碰撞且进度最优的区域。广泛的闭环评估表明，G2DP在nuPlan上实现了最先进性能，在反应性评分上超越最强的模仿学习基线7.2个百分点。在零样本迁移至interPlan和DeepScenario基准测试中，其保持最高评分，且在interPlan上碰撞避免能力相比无引导方法提升10.15。这些结果表明，时空代价网格可作为扩散规划中鲁棒引导的有效表征。

title: OmniContact: Chaining Meta-Skills via Contact Flow for Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Learning long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation poses a dual challenge: it requires not only the robust execution of meta-skills but also their seamless, closed-loop chaining equipped with autonomous recovery. Existing approaches remain limited: explicit humanoid-object interaction representations offer precision but are notoriously difficult for high-level planning, whereas implicit skill embeddings are compact but lack the interpretability required for reliable composition. We propose \ours, a hierarchical framework centered on \textbf{contact flow (CF)}, a compact representation consisting of key body trajectories and time-series binary contact signals. Leveraging this shared interface, our low-level policy \textbf{CF-Track} learns a unified library of loco-manipulation skills, while our high-level module \textbf{CF-Gen} heuristically synthesizes future contact-flow sequences. To support this setting, we additionally collect the OmniContact dataset, a MoCap-based HOI corpus for humanoid loco-manipulation (Appendix~\ref{sec:dataset}). Together, they enable robust execution, autonomous failure recovery, and flexible composition of meta-skills for long-horizon tasks. Experiments show that OmniContact achieves \(98.7\%\) success on \textit{Carry Box} and \(76.5\%\) on \textit{Push-Stack Boxes}, outperforming prior baselines by average margins of \(40.9\%\) in meta-skill and \(66.5\%\) in skill chaining. Besides, our framework naturally integrates with VLMs for semantic task decomposition, enabling complex, semantically grounded loco-manipulation behaviors, such as arranging scattered boxes into a heart shape.
tldr: This paper proposes OmniContact, a hierarchical framework using contact flow representations to chain meta-skills for humanoid loco-manipulation, achieving high success rates on long-horizon tasks and integrating with VLMs for semantic decomposition.
tldr_zh: 本文提出OmniContact，一种使用接触流表示来链接元技能以进行人形机器人移动操作的分层框架，在长时域任务上取得了高成功率，并与VLM结合实现了语义分解。
summary_zh: 学习长时域人形机器人移动操作面临双重挑战：不仅需要稳健执行元技能，还需实现其具备自主恢复能力的闭环无缝链式组合。现有方法仍存在局限：显式的人机交互表征虽具有精确性，但难以适用于高层规划；隐式技能编码虽紧凑，却缺乏可靠组合所需的可解释性。我们提出以\textbf{接触流（CF）}为核心的层级框架——该紧凑表征由关键身体轨迹与时序二值接触信号组成。通过这一共享接口，底层策略\textbf{CF-Track}学习统一的移动操作技能库，顶层模块\textbf{CF-Gen}则启发式地合成未来接触流序列。为支撑该设定，我们额外收集了OmniContact数据集——基于动作捕捉的人形机器人移动操作人机交互语料库（附录~\ref{sec:dataset}）。三者协同实现了长时域任务的稳健执行、自主故障恢复及元技能的灵活组合。实验表明，OmniContact在\textit{搬运箱子}任务中达到\(98.7\%\)成功率，在\textit{推叠箱子}任务中达到\(76.5\%\)成功率，在元技能与技能链式组合上分别超越此前基线方法平均\(40.9\%\)和\(66.5\%\)。此外，本框架可自然集成视觉语言模型实现语义化任务分解，从而支持复杂的、基于语义的移动操作行为，例如将散落箱子排列成心形。

title: Action ControlNet: A Lightweight Delay-Aware Adapter for Smooth Asynchronous Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robot manipulation, but their inference latency remains a major obstacle to stable high-frequency control. Asynchronous execution mitigates this bottleneck by overlapping policy inference with action execution, yet the next action chunk is still predicted from stale observations while the robot continues to move. Direct chunk stitching therefore introduces handoff discontinuities, action jitter, and failures in contact-rich manipulation. Existing remedies typically require either full-policy retraining or architecture-specific runtime logic. This work proposes Action ControlNet (ACNet), a lightweight delay-aware adapter that uses the executed motion suffix as a residual condition for a mostly frozen action head. ACNet leaves the pretrained backbone unchanged, introduces few trainable parameters, and remains compatible with generative action heads such as diffusion and flow matching. On Kinetix, Meta-World MT50, and a real-world SO-ARM101 platform, ACNet improves robustness under inference delay and yields smoother asynchronous trajectories than direct chunk stitching, while remaining more lightweight than full delay-conditioned retraining.
tldr: ACNet is a lightweight delay-aware adapter that smooths asynchronous control in VLA models by using the executed motion suffix as a residual condition for a frozen action head, reducing discontinuities without full retraining.
tldr_zh: ACNet 是一种轻量级延迟感知适配器，通过将已执行的运动后缀作为冻结动作头的残差条件，平滑 VLA 模型中的异步控制，减少不连续性且无需完全重训练。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面展现出强大潜力，但其推理延迟仍是实现稳定高频控制的主要障碍。异步执行通过将策略推理与动作执行重叠来缓解这一瓶颈，但当机器人持续运动时，下一动作块仍基于过时的观测数据进行预测。因此，直接拼接动作块会导致交接不连续、动作抖动以及在接触密集操作中的失败。现有解决方案通常需要完整的策略重训练或特定于架构的运行时逻辑。本文提出动作控制网络（ACNet），一种轻量级延迟感知适配器，利用已执行的运动后缀作为大部分冻结动作头的残差条件。ACNet保留预训练主干网络不变，仅引入少量可训练参数，且兼容扩散模型和流匹配等生成式动作头。在Kinetix、Meta-World MT50及真实世界SO-ARM101平台上，ACNet在推理延迟下提升了鲁棒性，生成的异步轨迹比直接拼接动作块更平滑，同时比完整的延迟条件重训练方案更轻量化。

title: LiMoDE: Rethinking Lifelong Robot Manipulation from a Mixture-of-Dynamic-Experts Perspective
summary: Building a generalist robot that can leverage prior knowledge for continuous task adaptation remains a significant challenge. Previous works alleviate the catastrophic forgetting problem by parameter-efficient fine-tuning for single-task adaptation. However, they fail to extract reusable skills and model the interaction with other skills effectively. Recent works try to address these issues by learning prompts. Differently, this paper presents an architectural perspective on the Lifelong Mixture of Dynamic Experts (\textit{LiMoDE}), a novel two-stage learning scheme for lifelong robot manipulation. Specifically, a dynamic MoE structure is first proposed in the multi-task pre-training stage to learn prior knowledge, where a varied number of heterogeneous experts are activated based on the motion information to address different short-term manipulations. Subsequently, in the task adaptation stage, we design a lifelong MoE adaptation mechanism % (LiMoEAM) that learns lifelong experts and dynamically combines them with frozen ones for new tasks, facilitating the knowledge transfer during adaptation. The proposed \textit{LiMoDE} is evaluated on both the simulated lifelong learning benchmark and real-world tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in achieving superior performance and strong lifelong adaptation by introducing a moderate number of additional trainable parameters and inference overhead.
tldr: LiMoDE proposes a mixture-of-dynamic-experts architecture for lifelong robot manipulation, combining multi-task pre-training with dynamic expert activation and a lifelong adaptation mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and enable skill transfer.
tldr_zh: LiMoDE提出了一种基于动态专家混合架构的终身机器人操作方案，通过多任务预训练和终身专家适应机制，缓解灾难性遗忘并实现技能迁移。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
构建能够利用先验知识实现连续任务自适应调整的通用型机器人仍是一项重大挑战。先前的工作通过针对单任务自适应的参数高效微调来缓解灾难性遗忘问题，但未能提取可复用技能，也未能有效建模技能间的交互。近期研究尝试通过学习提示（prompts）解决上述问题。本文则从架构角度提出动态专家终身混合模型（Lifelong Mixture of Dynamic Experts, \textit{LiMoDE}），一种面向终身机器人操作的两阶段学习方案。具体而言，在多任务预训练阶段首先提出动态MoE结构以学习先验知识，该结构根据运动信息激活数量不等的异构专家来处理不同短期操作。随后，在任务自适应阶段，我们设计了一种终身MoE自适应机制，通过学习终身专家并将其与冻结专家动态组合以应对新任务，从而促进自适应过程中的知识迁移。所提出的\textit{LiMoDE}在模拟终身学习基准测试和真实世界任务中均得到评估。大量实验证明，通过引入适度数量的额外可训练参数与推理开销，该方法在实现优越性能与强终身自适应能力方面具有有效性。

title: StairMaster: Learning to Conquer Risky Hollow Stairs for Agile Quadrupedal Robots
summary:
Climbing hollow stairs remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots due to the high risk of leg trapping, severe depth sparsity, and high-frequency depth-sensing noise. In this paper, we propose StairMaster, a novel three-stage reinforcement learning framework for stable locomotion on such extreme discontinuous terrains. Our architecture integrates a Cross-Attention mechanism to extract structural features from noisy depth data, alongside a Spatial-aware Recurrent Unit (SRU) that maintains robust spatio-temporal memory to mitigate perception blind spots. To bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception, we propose a high-fidelity sim-to-real depth sensor modeling pipeline that faithfully replicates real-world sensor artifacts. Additionally, we employ a 3D waypoint-guided active perception reward for proactive sensing, alongside hollow gap kinematic and stair edge penalties to ensure precise foothold placement. We successfully deployed StairMaster on a Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrating its ability to conquer hollow stairs with an unprecedented incline of up to 55$^\circ$ through zero-shot transfer. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first RL-based policy to achieve such steep hollow stair climbing in real-world environments.
  Project Website: https://sivan666666.github.io/StairMaster/.
tldr: This paper presents StairMaster, a reinforcement learning framework with Cross-Attention and Spatial-aware Recurrent Unit for quadrupedal locomotion on risky hollow stairs, achieving zero-shot transfer to a real robot on inclines up to 55°.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了StairMaster，一种结合交叉注意力机制和空间感知循环单元的强化学习框架，用于四足机器人在危险空心楼梯上的稳定 locomotion，在现实世界中实现了高达55°坡度的零样本迁移。
summary_zh:
摘要：攀爬镂空楼梯对四足机器人而言仍是一项极具挑战性的问题，主要面临腿部卡陷风险高、深度信息极度稀疏以及高频深度感知噪声等难题。本文提出StairMaster——一种新颖的三阶段强化学习框架，用于在此类极端非连续地形上实现稳定运动。我们的架构集成交叉注意力机制，可从含噪深度数据中提取结构特征，并配备空间感知循环单元（SRU）以维持稳健的时空记忆，从而缓解感知盲区。为弥合深度感知中的仿真到现实差距，我们提出高保真的仿真到现实深度传感器建模流程，能够真实复现现实世界中的传感器伪影。此外，我们采用基于3D路标引导的主动感知奖励机制促进前瞻性感知，同时引入镂空间隙运动学约束与楼梯边缘惩罚项确保精确的落脚点选择。我们成功在宇树Go2机器人上部署StairMaster，通过零样本迁移实现了对倾角高达55°的镂空楼梯的征服。据我们所知，这是首个在真实环境中实现如此陡峭镂空楼梯攀爬的基于强化学习的策略。

项目网站：https://sivan666666.github.io/StairMaster/

title: Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy for Multi-Stage Robotic Polishing
summary: Polishing is a critical finishing process in high-end manufacturing fields such as aerospace, where surface quality directly affects the service performance and reliability of components. Robotic imitation learning provides a flexible solution for such tasks, but current methods remain limited in industrial polishing because of long-horizon dependencies, uncertain stage transitions, and the difficulty of modeling and regulating coupled process parameters. To address these issues, this paper proposes a Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy (SRDP) for robotic polishing. SRDP infers the process-stage posterior from multimodal observation histories and uses it to condition the shared reverse denoising process, enabling stage-consistent action generation without external stage labels during execution. Furthermore, a roughness-oriented process-constrained diffusion sampling method is incorporated to generate constrained feed speed and normal contact force under stage-wise preset spindle speeds, thereby improving process consistency and physical feasibility. Systematic experiments are conducted on two representative scenarios, namely spacecraft cabin coating-surface polishing and inner-cavity structural surface finishing. Comparisons with advanced baselines, ablation studies, and real-robot validations comprehensively evaluate the proposed method. The results show that SRD improves stage-transition stability, process-parameter consistency, and final surface quality across different polishing scenarios.
tldr: Proposes a Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy (SRDP) for multi-stage robotic polishing that infers process-stage posterior from observation histories and uses roughness-constrained diffusion sampling to improve stage transitions, parameter consistency, and surface quality.
tldr_zh: 提出一种阶段感知和粗糙度约束的扩散策略（SRDP），用于多阶段机器人抛光，通过从观测历史推断工序阶段后验并采用粗糙度约束的扩散采样来改善阶段过渡、参数一致性和表面质量。
summary_zh: 抛光是航空航天等高端制造领域中的关键精加工工序，表面质量直接影响零部件的服役性能与可靠性。机器人模仿学习为此类任务提供了灵活的解决方案，但现有方法在工业抛光中仍受到长期依赖、阶段转换不确定以及耦合工艺参数建模与调控困难等限制。针对上述问题，本文提出了一种面向阶段感知与粗糙度约束的扩散策略（SRDP）用于机器人抛光。SRDP从多模态观测历史中推断工艺阶段后验，并利用该信息调节共享逆向去噪过程，从而在执行过程中无需外部阶段标签即可生成阶段一致的动作序列。此外，引入了一种面向粗糙度的工艺约束扩散采样方法，在阶段预设主轴转速下生成约束的进给速度与法向接触力，进而提升工艺一致性与物理可行性。本文在两个代表性场景（航天器舱体涂层表面抛光与内腔结构表面精整）中开展了系统实验，通过与先进基线方法的对比、消融实验以及真实机器人验证，对所提方法进行了全面评估。结果表明，SRDP在不同抛光场景中提升了阶段转换稳定性、工艺参数一致性及最终表面质量。

title: Learning Asynchronous Upper-body Task-space Trajectory Tracking Policy for Humanoid Robots
summary: High-level humanoid planners often output sparse task-space, low-rate trajectories, whereas whole-body controllers run at high frequency. This creates temporal asynchrony between the planning and execution, and structural incompleteness for full-body control. We propose an asynchronous upper body task-space tracking framework for humanoids. A student policy is initialized by teacher-student distillation, conditioned on the full cached future trajectory and an execution-time index, and trained with a sliding-window global reward to reduce frame drift without explicit frame estimation. For task-specific post-training, an MPC module completes sparse references into floating-base and upper-body guidance, while action- and FK level self-guidance constrain policy drift. Simulation and Unitree G1 hardware experiments show improved tracking under low update rates, stronger performance than synchronous and decoupled baselines, and safer adaptation to out-of-distribution motions.
tldr: Proposes an asynchronous upper-body task-space tracking framework for humanoid robots that uses teacher-student distillation, sliding-window global reward, and MPC-based reference completion to handle low-rate sparse planning inputs.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于人形机器人的异步上肢任务空间跟踪框架，通过师生蒸馏、滑动窗口全局奖励和基于MPC的参考补全来处理低频率稀疏规划输入。
summary_zh: 高水平人形机器人规划器通常输出稀疏的任务空间、低速率轨迹，而全身控制器则以高频运行。这导致规划与执行之间存在时间异步性，并造成全身控制的结构不完整性。我们提出了一种用于人形机器人的异步上半身任务空间跟踪框架。通过教师-学生蒸馏初始化学生策略，该策略以完整缓存的未来轨迹和执行时间索引为条件，并采用滑动窗口全局奖励进行训练，从而在无需显式帧估计的情况下减少帧漂移。针对特定任务的后期训练，MPC模块将稀疏参考补全为浮动基座和上半身引导，同时动作层和正向运动学层的自引导约束策略漂移。仿真与宇树G1硬件实验表明，该方法在低更新率下实现了更优的跟踪性能，优于同步与解耦基线方案，并对分布外运动具有更安全的适应能力。

title: RMTL: Reinforced Micro-task Learning for Long-Horizon Manipulation with VLM Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic manipulation often requires manually designing a dense reward function, which is difficult to tune and often fragile, or learning a reward from human demonstrations or preferences, which can be expensive. A recent line of work uses pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) as zero-shot reward models, replacing these costs with a single text prompt. However, we argue that a single global prompt is too coarse for long-horizon manipulation tasks with randomized initial conditions. The single-prompt VLM reward is near-flat for much of the trajectory, making early progress hard for the agent to detect. We propose Reinforced Micro-Task Learning (RMTL), an approach that decomposes a manipulation task into a small set of language-described micro-tasks and trains the agent to switch between them. At each step, the agent receives a multi-view VLM reward computed using the prompt of the currently active micro-task and averaged across multiple camera views to reduce the effect of view-specific occlusions. A reverse curriculum gradually exposes the agent to harder initial conditions, while a PPO worker is first trained with a fixed distance-based rule that selects the active micro-task. We then replace this rule with a learned hierarchical manager, turning rule-based phase selection into a fully learned hierarchical policy. We instantiate RMTL on the Fetch manipulation environment using three short stage-specific prompts and without additional prompt tuning. Experiments show that RMTL provides more informative reward signals than single-prompt VLM rewards, enabling faster learning. These results suggest that decomposing VLM rewards into micro-task-specific language prompts can substantially improve the scalability of language-guided reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation.
tldr: RMTL decomposes long-horizon manipulation tasks into micro-tasks with separate VLM prompts and a learned hierarchical manager, yielding more informative rewards and faster RL training.
tldr_zh: RMTL将长时程操作任务分解为微任务，每个微任务使用独立的VLM提示，并通过学习到的层次化管理器，提供更丰富的奖励信号，从而加速强化学习训练。
summary_zh: 基于强化学习的机器人操作任务通常需要人工设计稠密奖励函数，这类函数难以调参且易脆弱失效，或需通过人类示教/偏好学习奖励函数，但成本高昂。近期研究利用预训练视觉语言模型作为零样本奖励模型，通过单次文本提示替代上述成本。然而，我们认为单一全局提示对于具有随机初始条件的长时域操作任务过于粗糙：单提示VLM奖励在大部分轨迹中近乎平坦，导致智能体难以检测早期进步。本文提出强化微任务学习（RMTL），该方法将操作任务分解为少量语言描述的微任务，并训练智能体在微任务间切换。每一步中，智能体接收基于当前活跃微任务提示计算的多视角VLM奖励，并通过多摄像机视角平均降低特定视角遮挡的影响。逆向课程逐步将智能体暴露于更困难的初始条件，而PPO工作器首先基于固定距离规则选择活跃微任务进行训练，随后以学习型层级管理器替代该规则，使基于规则的相位选择转化为完全学习的层级策略。我们在Fetch操作环境中实例化RMTL，仅使用三个简短阶段特定提示且无需额外提示调优。实验表明，RMTL比单提示VLM奖励提供更丰富的奖励信号，实现更快的收敛速度。这些结果表明，将VLM奖励分解为微任务特定语言提示可显著提升语言引导强化学习在机器人操作中的可扩展性。

title: 1000 Rallies: An Event-Camera Dataset and Real-Time Learned Ball-State Estimation for Robotic Table Tennis
summary: Robotic table tennis has emerged as a compelling benchmark for real-time robotic perception due to its fast ball dynamics and stringent timing requirements. Accurate, high-frequency, and low-latency ball state estimation is critical for reliable trajectory prediction and timely control. Traditional frame-based cameras face an inherent trade-off: low frame rates leave temporal blind spots that miss fast-moving objects and high frame rates raise data and computational cost. Event cameras instead offer microsecond temporal resolution and, under sufficient illumination, remain largely free of motion blur even at high ball speeds. However, the community lacks large-scale datasets to develop and benchmark event-based perception in realistic sports scenarios. We address this gap by introducing the first large-scale event-camera dataset for table tennis, comprising over 1000 rallies from a diverse group of players ranging from amateurs to elite-level athletes. Each recording captures the event stream alongside 14 synchronized high-speed frame-based cameras at 200 FPS, which we use to produce 1 kHz pseudo ground-truth labels for ball position, velocity, and spin. Building on this dataset, we train a convolutional neural network robust to background player motion that jointly estimates the ball's position and velocity in the image-plane from events. Treating the predicted velocity as an additional measurement in the Kalman filter reduces bounce-point prediction error by 36% relative to a position-only baseline. Finally, we close the perception-action loop by integrating the event-based system with a Stäubli robotic arm, enabling the first real-time human-robot table tennis rallies driven by event-based perception.
tldr: This paper presents the first large-scale event-camera dataset for table tennis, comprising over 1000 rallies with high-frequency labels, and demonstrates real-time ball state estimation with a Kalman filter and a CNN that closes the perception-action loop on a robotic arm.
tldr_zh: 本文首次提出了用于乒乓球的大规模事件相机数据集，包含超过1000次回合和1kHz的伪真值标签，并展示了结合CNN与卡尔曼滤波的实时球状态估计方法，最终在机器人手臂上实现了事件驱动的人机对打。
summary_zh: 机器人乒乓球因其快速的球体动力学和严格的时间要求，已成为实时机器人感知领域中一个引人注目的基准测试。对球体状态进行精确、高频且低延迟的估计，对于可靠的轨迹预测和及时的控制至关重要。传统的基于帧的相机面临一个固有的权衡：低帧率会留下时间盲点，导致无法捕捉快速移动的物体，而高帧率则会增加数据和计算成本。相比之下，事件相机提供了微秒级的时间分辨率，并且在充足光照条件下，即使在高速球体运动时也基本不会出现运动模糊。然而，该领域缺乏大规模数据集来开发和评估现实体育场景中基于事件的感知能力。我们通过引入首个用于乒乓球的大规模事件相机数据集来填补这一空白，该数据集包含来自从业余爱好者到精英运动员等不同水平球员的1000多个回合。每次录制同时捕获事件流以及14台以200 FPS同步的高速帧基相机，我们利用这些数据生成了1 kHz的伪真值标签，用于标注球体的位置、速度和旋转。基于该数据集，我们训练了一个对背景球员运动具有鲁棒性的卷积神经网络，该网络能够从事件中联合估计球体在图像平面上的位置和速度。将预测的速度作为卡尔曼滤波器中的额外测量值，与仅依赖位置的基线方法相比，可将弹跳点预测误差降低36%。最后，我们通过将基于事件的感知系统与Stäubli机械臂集成，闭环了感知-动作回路，从而首次实现了由事件感知驱动的实时人机乒乓球对打。

title: WOLF-VLA: Whole-Body Humanoid Optimal Locomotion Framework for Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet their applicability to whole-body, contact-rich humanoid locomotion remains severely underexplored due to data scarcity, the absence of dynamically consistent demonstrations, and the difficulty of encoding optimality and safety in learning-based pipelines. This work introduces a unified framework WOLF-VLA that integrates whole-body optimal-control (OC) motion synthesis with large-scale multi-modal dataset to train VLAs capable of generating humanoid locomotion policies directly from natural-language instructions. We construct a comprehensive dataset of dynamically feasible humanoid trajectories across six locomotion-related task families, each parameterized by environmental variations, object colors, placements, and visual distractors. We train a VLA model using the collected joint trajectories, ego-centric visual observations and natural language instruction, yielding a policy that exhibits strong reasoning and robustness to initial-condition variability, and competitive performance across several tasks and environment settings. A systematic ablation study demonstrates the impact of each modality on the model performance. The full dataset, model checkpoints, and benchmarking simulation suite will be openly released, establishing a reproducible dynamically consistent benchmark for whole-body humanoid locomotion rich VLA control and enabling future research in scalable transfer of instruction-driven locomotion policies.
tldr: WOLF-VLA integrates whole-body optimal control motion synthesis with large-scale multimodal data to train VLA models that generate humanoid locomotion policies from natural language instructions, addressing the lack of dynamically consistent demonstrations for whole-body humanoid locomotion.
tldr_zh: WOLF-VLA将全身最优控制运动合成与大规模多模态数据相结合，训练VLA模型从自然语言指令生成仿人运动策略，解决了全身仿人运动缺乏动态一致演示的问题。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型近期在机器人操作中展现出强大的泛化能力，但其在全身、密集接触的人形机器人运动领域的应用仍严重缺乏探索，主要原因包括数据稀缺、缺乏动态一致的演示数据，以及基于学习框架中难以编码最优性与安全性。本研究提出统一框架WOLF-VLA，将全身最优控制运动合成与大规模多模态数据集相结合，训练能够直接从自然语言指令生成人形机器人运动策略的视觉-语言-动作模型。我们构建了一个包含六类运动相关任务家族、涵盖动态可行的人形轨迹的综合数据集，每类任务均通过环境变化、物体颜色、摆放位置及视觉干扰因素进行参数化。利用采集的关节轨迹、第一人称视觉观测及自然语言指令训练视觉-语言-动作模型，所得策略展现出强大的推理能力、对初始条件变化的鲁棒性，并在多项任务与环境设定中取得具有竞争力的表现。系统性的消融实验揭示了各模态对模型性能的影响。完整数据集、模型检查点及基准测试仿真套件将开源发布，为全身人形机器人运动丰富的视觉-语言-动作控制建立可复现的动态一致基准，并推动指令驱动运动策略可扩展迁移的未来研究。

title: One Body, Two Minds: Variable Autonomy Approach for a Co-embodied Robotic Hand
summary:
Assistive robotic systems face a fundamental trade-off: fully autonomous systems lack user agency, while fully user-controlled systems demand continuous cognitive effort. Existing shared autonomy approaches blend human and robot commands but are mostly deployed in separate physical bodies. We introduce co-embodiment with variable autonomy, where human and robot share a single physical body and operate at different autonomy levels across task phases, from mutual autonomy during object search and grasping to human-dominant control during actuation.
  We present a co-embodied, wearable robotic hand that has its own ``mind'' and operates with variable autonomy levels. A learning-from-demonstration visuomotor diffusion policy enables autonomous grasping when the user positions the hand near known objects. Once grasped, the system signals completion and the human can actuate the grasped tool (drill, spray bottle, infrared thermometer, lighter, and ice-cream scoop) via hands-free head gestures. The human retains veto authority at all times through a release gesture that returns the system to the initial phase. Unlike blended autonomy, where control is continuously negotiated, our co-embodied approach consists of variable autonomy from full human control to full independent actions while maintaining physical coupling, realizing a one body, two minds paradigm.
  In a user study with 44 participants performing five bimanual tasks, users rapidly adapted to this ``two minds'' paradigm: completion times improved by 23.3% across trials ($p < 0.001$, Cohen's $d = 0.94$), the best-performing policy variant reached a 93.6% task success rate, and acceptance ratings were high (5.70/7 overall impression, 5.52/7 daily use willingness). This work establishes co-embodiment with variable autonomy as a viable approach for assistive robotics, enabling human-robot collaboration through co-embodiment.
tldr: This paper presents a co-embodied robotic hand that uses variable autonomy (mutual autonomy for search/grasp, human-dominant for actuation) with a visuomotor diffusion policy, validated by a user study showing rapid adaptation and high success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种共体机器人手，采用可变自主性（搜索/抓取时相互自主，操作时人类主导）和视觉运动扩散策略，用户研究显示快速适应和高成功率。
summary_zh:
辅助机器人系统面临一个基本权衡：全自主系统缺乏用户主导性，而全用户控制系统需要持续的认知投入。现有的共享自主方法融合了人类与机器人的指令，但大多部署在独立的物理实体中。我们提出了具有可变自主性的共体化方案，即人类与机器人共享单一物理实体，在不同任务阶段以不同自主等级运行——从物体搜索与抓取阶段的相互自主，到执行操作阶段的人类主导控制。

我们展示了一种共体化可穿戴机械手，它拥有自己的"思维"，并以可变自主等级运行。基于示教学习的视觉运动扩散策略使系统能够在用户将手部靠近已知物体时自主完成抓取。抓取完成后，系统发出完成信号，用户可通过免手持头部手势操作所抓取的工具（电钻、喷雾瓶、红外温度计、打火机及冰淇淋勺）。用户始终保留否决权，可通过释放手势使系统返回初始阶段。与自主性持续协商的融合式自主不同，我们的共体化方法包含从完全人类控制到完全独立行动的可变自主性，同时保持物理耦合，实现了"一体双智"范式。

在44名参与者执行五项双手任务的用户研究中，用户迅速适应了这种"双智"范式：试验间完成时间提升23.3%（p < 0.001，Cohen's d = 0.94），最优策略变体达到93.6%的任务成功率，接受度评分较高（总体印象5.70/7，日常使用意愿5.52/7）。本项工作确立了具有可变自主性的共体化作为辅助机器人的可行方案，通过共体化实现人机协作。

title: SAGE-Nav: Leveraging LLM Planning and Alignment Fusion for Hierarchical Scene Graph-Guided Navigation
summary: Object-Goal Navigation (ObjNav) requires embodied agents to autonomously locate specified targets using only egocentric visual observations. Existing monolithic methods struggle with long-horizon reasoning and generalize poorly to novel environments. To address these limitations, we propose SAGE-Nav, a novel hierarchical framework that integrates the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with dynamic scene graphs. Crucially, it decouples asynchronous global semantic planning from the high-frequency reactive control loop. The LLM serves as a global planner, decomposing abstract instructions into a sequence of semantically grounded waypoints. To translate these plans into dense multi-modal guidance, we design a Hierarchical Scene Graph Encoder (HSGE) that leverages relational graph convolutions to produce structure-aware embeddings preserving both semantic and spatial topology. Furthermore, we develop the Goal-aware Alignment-Fusion Network (GAFN) to dynamically fuse real-time perception with these structural priors. Using an adaptive gating mechanism with an explicit inductive bias, GAFN ensures robust visual-topological alignment for the low-level policy. Extensive evaluations in the i-THOR and RoboTHOR environments demonstrate that SAGE-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering substantial gains in navigation efficiency and zero-shot generalization while maintaining the low control latency required for physical robotic deployment.
tldr: SAGE-Nav integrates LLM planning with hierarchical scene graphs for object-goal navigation, decoupling global semantic planning from reactive control.
tldr_zh: SAGE-Nav 将 LLM 规划与层次化场景图相结合，用于物体目标导航，将全局语义规划与反应式控制解耦。
summary_zh: 目标导向导航要求具身智能体仅依靠自我中心的视觉观测自主定位指定目标。现有单一架构方法在长时序推理方面存在困难，且难以泛化至新环境。针对这些局限，我们提出SAGE-Nav——一种将大语言模型的推理能力与动态场景图相结合的新型分层框架。关键在于，该框架实现了异步全局语义规划与高频反应式控制回路的解耦。大语言模型作为全局规划器，将抽象指令分解为一系列语义锚定的航路点。为将这些规划转化为密集的多模态引导，我们设计了分层场景图编码器，利用关系图卷积生成保留语义与空间拓扑的结构感知嵌入。进一步，我们开发了目标感知对齐融合网络，通过具有显式归纳偏置的自适应门控机制，将实时感知与结构先验进行动态融合，确保底层策略具备鲁棒的视觉-拓扑对齐能力。在i-THOR和RoboTHOR环境中的广泛评估表明，SAGE-Nav达到了最先进性能，在导航效率和零样本泛化能力上取得显著提升，同时保持了物理机器人部署所需的低控制延迟。

title: Decoupling Semantics and Geometric Grounding: Spatial Visual Prompts for Language-Conditioned Imitation Learning
summary: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise in robotic manipulation, their monolithic paradigm inherently couples semantic reasoning and spatial control. This creates a severe alignment bottleneck, limiting precise target disambiguation in data-constrained imitation learning. To overcome this, we propose SVP-IL, a decoupled architecture that explicitly extracts spatial visual grounding from the action generation loop. By leveraging vision-language foundation models, we parse instructions into zero-shot geometric masks, translating language into explicit Spatial Visual Prompts (SVP). These priors are injected into a continuous action generator via a lightweight direct feature-level fusion mechanism. This integration provides explicit and uncorrupted spatial gradient guidance while ensuring highly stable optimization under low-data regimes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVP-IL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art VLAs and pure visuomotor baselines. Trained on as few as 50 to 100 demonstrations, SVP-IL improves average success rates on highly ambiguous language-conditioned tasks from 24.0% to 39.5%, achieving 67.8% on standard benchmarks. Real-world robotic experiments further validate its robustness and data efficiency in unstructured physical environments.
tldr: This paper introduces SVP-IL, a decoupled architecture for language-conditioned robotic manipulation that separates semantic grounding and action generation by using vision-language models to produce spatial visual prompts, enabling data-efficient imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SVP-IL，一种解耦的语言条件机器人操作架构，通过视觉语言模型生成空间视觉提示来分离语义理解和动作生成，实现数据高效的模仿学习。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出潜力，但其整体式架构天然地将语义推理与空间控制耦合在一起。这造成了严重的对齐瓶颈，限制了数据受限模仿学习中精确目标消歧的能力。为克服这一问题，我们提出SVP-IL，一种解耦架构，它从动作生成环路中显式提取空间视觉定位信息。通过利用视觉-语言基础模型，我们将指令解析为零样本几何掩码，将语言转化为显式的空间视觉提示（SVP）。这些先验信息通过轻量化的直接特征级融合机制注入连续动作生成器。这种集成在提供显式且无污染的空间梯度引导的同时，确保了低数据量场景下的高度稳定优化。大量实验表明，SVP-IL显著优于最先进的VLA模型及纯视觉运动基线。在仅使用50至100个示范样本训练的条件下，SVP-IL将高歧义语言条件任务的平均成功率从24.0%提升至39.5%，并在标准基准测试中达到67.8%。实际机器人实验进一步验证了其在非结构化物理环境中的鲁棒性与数据效率。

title: Reflective VLA: In-Context Action Consequences Make VLAs Generalize
summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models are reactive: they predict the next action from the current instruction and observation, implicitly assuming that the current observation fully specifies the action-relevant state. In embodied control, however, embodiment-specific factors such as camera-to-robot geometry, robot calibration, or systematic actuation bias are often hard to identify from a single observation. As a result, reactive policies cannot reliably disambiguate these factors in general, overfitting to training environments and generalizing poorly at deployment. We propose Reflective VLA, which conditions each decision on a context of observation-action-consequence triplets. Each triplet records not only what the robot observed and executed, but also how the scene changed afterward, exposing the deployment-specific mapping from actions to observed effects. Architecturally, Reflective VLA routes all observation modalities through the VLM under shared attention, so the action expert reasons directly over past triplets and the current observation. A block-causal mask enables parallel multi-frame training without leakage and supports KV-cached real-time inference. On standard LIBERO and SimplerEnv-Bridge, Reflective VLA preserves strong in-distribution performance. Under distribution shift on LIBERO-Plus and the harder LIBERO-Plus-Hard, it improves average success rate by 5.4 and 4.2 percentage points over a matched reactive baseline. Ablations with a matched history-only baseline further show that action consequences -- rather than additional context length alone -- are the key to cross-environment generalization. Project page: https://lianqing11.github.io/reflective-vla-page/
tldr: Reflective VLA introduces a method that conditions action prediction on observation-action-consequence triplets to capture deployment-specific action effects, improving generalization under distribution shift in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Reflective VLA 通过将动作预测建立在观察-动作-结果三元组上，捕捉部署环境特有的动作效果，从而在操作任务中提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是反应式的：它们根据当前指令和观测预测下一个动作，隐含地假设当前观测完全指定了与动作相关的状态。然而，在具身控制中，诸如相机与机器人的几何关系、机器人标定或系统性驱动偏差等具身特异性因素，往往难以从单次观测中识别。因此，反应式策略通常无法可靠地消除这些因素的歧义，会过拟合训练环境并在部署时泛化能力较差。我们提出反思式VLA（Reflective VLA），该方法将每个决策基于观测-动作-后果三元组构成的上下文。每个三元组不仅记录了机器人观测和执行的内容，还记录了场景随后发生的变化，从而揭示了从动作到观测效果的部署特异性映射。在架构上，反思式VLA通过共享注意力机制将所有观测模态路由至视觉语言模型（VLM），使得动作推理专家能够直接基于过去的三元组和当前观测进行推理。块因果掩码（block-causal mask）支持无信息泄露的并行多帧训练，并支持基于键值缓存（KV-cache）的实时推理。在标准LIBERO和SimplerEnv-Bridge基准上，反思式VLA保持了较强的分布内性能。在LIBERO-Plus和更难的LIBERO-Plus-Hard分布偏移场景下，相较于匹配的反应式基线，其平均成功率分别提升了5.4和4.2个百分点。与仅使用历史信息的匹配基线的消融实验进一步表明，动作后果——而非仅仅是更长的上下文长度——是实现跨环境泛化的关键。项目页面：https://lianqing11.github.io/reflective-vla-page/

title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
summary: Long-term robot deployment requires a compact and scalable memory that preserves fine-grained visual semantics, grounds observations in space and time, and enables efficient storage and retrieval. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, an agentic memory system for long-horizon robotic question answering and navigation. RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database, and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer queries and navigate to goals. By operating directly on visual embeddings, RAVEN avoids lossy image-to-text captioning and enables accurate semantic, spatial, and temporal retrieval at scale. Across several simulated and real-world video question-answering benchmarks, RAVEN consistently surpasses caption-based memory systems and matches frontier VLMs on long-horizon tasks at 10$\times$ lower retrieval cost. Finally, we instantiate RAVEN on a Unitree Go1 robot for the task of long-horizon navigation for natural language goal-reaching, and show successful deployment over several large indoor environments.
tldr: RAVEN proposes a visuo-spatio-temporal memory system for long-horizon robotic navigation and QA, using visual embeddings with pose and time stored in a vector database and grounded via a spatial map, outperforming caption-based systems on real robot deployment.
tldr_zh: RAVEN 提出了一种面向长期机器人导航与问答的视觉-空间-时间记忆系统，通过向量数据库存储视觉嵌入与位姿时间，并基于空间图进行检索，在真实机器人部署上优于基于字幕的系统。
summary_zh: 长期机器人部署需要一种紧凑且可扩展的记忆系统，既能保留细粒度的视觉语义，又能将观测结果锚定于空间与时间维度，同时支持高效的存储与检索。本文提出RAVEN——一种面向长时域机器人问答与导航的智能体记忆系统。RAVEN将包含位姿与时间戳的视觉嵌入存入向量数据库，并基于空间地图实现检索，以回答查询并导航至目标位置。通过直接处理视觉嵌入，RAVEN避免了有损的图像到文本描述转换，从而在大规模应用中实现精确的语义、空间与时间检索。在多个模拟及真实场景的视频问答基准测试中，RAVEN始终优于基于文本描述的记忆系统，并以低10倍的检索成本在长时域任务中达到与前沿视觉语言模型相当的性能。最后，我们在Unitree Go1机器人上部署RAVEN，实现面向自然语言目标到达的长时域导航任务，并在多个大型室内环境中成功完成部署。

title: Causality-Based Parametric Control Barrier Function for Safe Multi-Vehicle Interaction
summary: Safe control has been widely studied in various safety-critical applications, for instance, autonomous driving. In order to ensure the autonomous vehicle does not collide with other vehicles, it is essential to obtain an accurate expectation of surrounding vehicles' behavior and react adaptively. Instead of assuming fully cooperative and homogeneous vehicles using the same safety-critical controllers, recent works have been exploring different data-driven approaches to model the neighboring vehicles' underlying controllers with observed data. However, existing works either suffer from 1) the inter-vehicle influence during the multi-vehicle interaction, which makes it hard to determine the causality of surrounding vehicles' behavior in controller modeling, or 2) being dominated by the worst-case analysis, which may lead to overly conservative behavior. In this paper, we extend the prior work on Parametric-Control Barrier Function (Parametric-CBF) to multi-robot interactions with embedded causality inference to explicitly reason over the inter-vehicle influence. Given the learned Causality-based Parametric-CBF, we present an adaptive safety-critical controller that allows the ego vehicle to safely react to surrounding vehicles with the learned expectation. We demonstrate that by leveraging the motion flexibility among multi-vehicle systems, task efficiency can be greatly improved in various interaction-intensive scenarios.
tldr: Extends Parametric-CBF with causality inference to model inter-vehicle influence, enabling adaptive safety-critical control that improves task efficiency in multi-vehicle interactions.
tldr_zh: 将因果关系推断扩展到参数化控制障碍函数中，以建模车辆间影响，实现自适应安全关键控制，提升多车交互场景下的任务效率。
summary_zh: 安全控制已在各类安全关键应用中（例如自动驾驶）得到广泛研究。为确保自动驾驶车辆不与周围车辆发生碰撞，必须准确预测周边车辆的行为并做出自适应响应。不同于假设所有车辆均完全协作且使用相同的安全关键控制器，近年来的研究逐渐探索利用数据驱动方法，通过观测数据对邻车的底层控制器进行建模。然而，现有方法存在以下问题：1）多车交互中的车辆间影响使得控制器建模时难以判断周围车辆行为的因果关系；2）受限于最坏情况分析，可能导致过于保守的行为。本文在参数化控制屏障函数（Parametric-CBF）的基础上，将其扩展至多机器人交互场景，并嵌入因果推断机制以显式推理车辆间影响。基于学习得到的因果参数化控制屏障函数，我们提出一种自适应安全关键控制器，使本车能够利用学习到的期望模型安全应对周边车辆。实验表明，通过利用多车系统的运动灵活性，各类高交互强度场景中的任务效率可得到显著提升。

title: RGB: RL Guided Whole-Body MPPI for Humanoid Control
summary: Humanoid robots require whole-body controllers that are both robust and precise in contact-rich environments. While deep reinforcement learning (RL) achieves robust stability, its behavior is tightly coupled to the training objective and command interface, making it difficult to add new feedback objectives without retraining. In this study, we propose an RL guided whole-body model predictive path integral (MPPI) framework that acts as an add-on feedback controller on top of a pretrained RL policy. Instead of using RL policy as the final controller, we use it as a sampling prior that biases MPPI rollouts toward dynamically feasible behaviors. Task objectives are specified through modular MPPI cost terms, and MPPI closes the loop by continuously correcting the RL prior online to satisfy these objectives without retraining the policy. Simulations on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid in MuJoCo demonstrate stable high-rate control (average 280~Hz). The proposed method improves task-level precision over a pure RL baseline under the same command interface. This is achieved by correcting systematic drift during straight walking and tracking additional whole-body reference signals imposed through the cost.
tldr: Proposes an RL-guided whole-body MPPI framework for humanoid control, using a pretrained RL policy as a sampling prior and online MPPI correction to improve task precision without retraining.
tldr_zh: 提出一种RL引导的全身MPPI框架用于人形机器人控制，利用预训练的RL策略作为采样先验，并通过在线MPPI修正来提高任务精度，无需重新训练。
summary_zh: 人形机器人需要能够在接触密集环境中兼具鲁棒性与精确性的全身控制器。尽管深度强化学习（RL）能够实现鲁棒的稳定性，但其行为与训练目标和指令接口紧密耦合，导致在不重新训练的情况下难以添加新的反馈目标。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于RL引导的全身模型预测路径积分（MPPI）框架，作为预训练RL策略之上的附加反馈控制器。我们并非将RL策略作为最终控制器，而是将其用作采样先验，使MPPI的 rollout 偏向于动态可行的行为。任务目标通过模块化的MPPI代价项进行定义，而MPPI通过持续在线修正RL先验来满足这些目标（无需重新训练策略），从而形成闭环控制。在MuJoCo中对29自由度Unitree G1人形机器人进行的仿真表明，该方法实现了稳定的高速率控制（平均280 Hz）。在相同指令接口下，所提方法相比纯RL基线提升了任务级精度。这一提升通过修正直行过程中的系统性漂移以及追踪通过代价项施加的额外全身参考信号来实现。

title: SurveilNav: Collaborative Object Goal Navigation with Robot and Surveillance System
summary: With the growing deployment of surveillance systems in factories, offices, and homes, integrating them with robots offers a promising direction for collaborative and efficient task execution. However, existing approaches largely focus on single-robot scenarios and struggle with multi-view collaboration in large-scale environments. In this paper, we present a novel indoor collaborative object navigation dataset built on Habitat-Sim, featuring 206 cameras across 74 floors. The dataset enables systematic evaluation of an agent's ability to exploit multi-view surveillance information. To address the limitations of single-robot perception, we propose SurveilNav, a collaborative navigation framework that integrates active camera scheduling, joint 2D/3D mapping, VLM-based value estimation, and collaborative target verification. By synergizing the robot's dynamic local perception with the static global view of surveillance, this architecture effectively overcomes both the limited perception range of single agents and the inherent blind spots of fixed cameras, resolving inefficient exploration. Experimental results on the HM3D dataset demonstrate that SurveilNav substantially outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both exploration efficiency and navigation success rate. Moreover, the system shows strong potential for applications in large-scale search, home environments, and rescue missions.
tldr: Proposes SurveilNav, a collaborative object-goal navigation framework that integrates active camera scheduling, joint 2D/3D mapping, and VLM-based value estimation to fuse robot and surveillance camera views, achieving SOTA on HM3D.
tldr_zh: 提出了SurveilNav，一种结合主动相机调度、联合2D/3D建图和VLM价值估计的协作目标导航框架，融合机器人与监控摄像头视角，在HM3D上达到SOTA。
summary_zh: 随着监控系统在工厂、办公室和家庭中的应用日益广泛，将其与机器人集成有望实现协同高效的任务执行。然而，现有方法主要聚焦于单机器人场景，难以应对大规模环境中的多视角协作问题。本文基于Habitat-Sim构建了一个新型室内协同物体导航数据集，该数据集包含74层楼中的206个摄像头，能够系统评估智能体利用多视角监控信息的能力。针对单机器人感知的局限性，我们提出了SurveilNav协同导航框架，该框架集成了主动摄像头调度、联合2D/3D建图、基于视觉语言模型的价值估计以及协同目标验证功能。通过将机器人的动态局部感知与监控系统的静态全局视角协同结合，该架构有效克服了单一智能体感知范围有限以及固定摄像头固有盲区的问题，解决了低效探索的困境。在HM3D数据集上的实验结果表明，SurveilNav显著优于现有方法，在探索效率和导航成功率方面均达到了最先进水平。此外，该系统在大规模搜索、家庭环境及救援任务中展现出强大的应用潜力。

title: BFMTrack: Latent Sequence Optimization for Physics-Based Motion Tracking with Behavioral Foundation Models
summary: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) offer a promising path toward universal physics-based character control by organizing a rich repertoire of physically plausible behaviors into a latent space, guided by a large-scale motion dataset. While these models excel at time-invariant tasks, such as goal-reaching and state-based reward optimization, their latent space does not directly support time-varying objectives, such as tracking a motion sequence. For tracking, existing heuristics rely on moving-window-averaging that fails to capture the nuances of highly dynamic motions. In this work, we propose a novel Latent Sequence Optimization (LSO) to address these shortcomings. Our approach combines simulation rollouts with a policy gradient update to optimize over a sequence of latents, extending the capabilities of BFMs toward precise motion tracking without requiring reward engineering and tuning. To guide the optimization toward smooth, coherent latent trajectories, we model the latent sequence using temporally correlated noise. We validate our approach across dense tracking, sparse keyframing, and direct deployment onto a real humanoid robot.
tldr: Proposes Latent Sequence Optimization (LSO) to enable Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) to track time-varying motion sequences by optimizing over latent trajectories with policy gradients, demonstrated on a real humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: 提出潜序列优化方法，使行为基础模型能够通过策略梯度优化潜轨迹来跟踪时变运动序列，并在真实人形机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 行为基础模型（BFMs）通过将丰富的物理合理行为组织到大规模运动数据引导的潜空间中，为构建通用的基于物理的角色控制提供了可行路径。尽管这些模型在时不变任务（如目标到达与基于状态的奖励优化）中表现优异，但它们的潜空间无法直接支持时变目标（如运动序列跟踪）。针对跟踪任务，现有启发式方法依赖滑动窗口平均，但难以捕捉高动态运动的细微特征。为此，本文提出一种新颖的潜空间序列优化方法（LSO），旨在解决上述缺陷。该方法通过结合仿真展开与策略梯度更新，对潜变量序列进行优化，在不需设计奖励函数与参数调优的前提下，将BFMs的能力拓展至精确运动跟踪。为进一步引导优化生成平滑且连贯的潜轨迹，我们采用时序相关噪声对潜序列进行建模。通过在密集跟踪、稀疏关键帧设定及真实人形机器人直接部署场景中的验证，证明了该方法的有效性。

title: Reward-Conditioned Attention: How Reward Design Shapes What Autonomous Driving Agents See
summary: We investigate how reward design shapes the internal attention patterns of reinforcement learning agents trained for autonomous driving. Using three Perceiver-based agents that share identical architectures and training data but differ only in their reward configurations$\unicode{x2014}$ranging from basic violation penalties to continuous proximity penalties$\unicode{x2014}$we analyze cross-attention allocation across 50 real-world scenarios from the Waymo Open Motion Dataset. A central methodological finding is that naïve pooling of timesteps across episodes substantially underestimates the attention$\unicode{x2013}$risk relationship; within-episode correlation with Fisher z-transform aggregation is the appropriate statistic and reveals a robustly positive link between collision risk and agent-directed attention. Building on this validated methodology, we demonstrate two reward-conditioned effects: agents trained with navigation rewards allocate up to $2.0\times$ more attention to GPS-path tokens than those trained with additional proximity penalties$\unicode{x2014}$and $4.7\times$ more than agents with no navigation incentive$\unicode{x2014}$revealing that reward content directly determines which scene elements the encoder prioritizes, and continuous time-to-collision penalties create a $\textit{learned vigilance prior}$$\unicode{x2014}$elevated resting agent surveillance maintained throughout collision-free phases. In several scenarios, the complete-reward and minimal-reward models exhibit opposite attention$\unicode{x2013}$risk correlation directions, demonstrating that reward design can qualitatively reverse attentional strategy rather than merely modulating its magnitude. These results suggest that attention analysis is a practical diagnostic for verifying that a reward function produces the intended representational behaviour in safety-critical RL systems.
tldr: This paper analyzes how reward design shapes the internal attention patterns of RL agents for autonomous driving, revealing that reward content directly determines which scene elements the encoder prioritizes and that reward design can qualitatively reverse attentional strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了奖励设计如何塑造用于自动驾驶的强化学习代理的内部注意力模式，揭示了奖励内容直接决定编码器优先考虑的场景元素，并且奖励设计可以在根本上逆转注意力策略方向。
summary_zh: 我们研究了奖励设计如何塑造用于自动驾驶的强化学习智能体的内部注意力模式。通过使用三个基于感知器（Perceiver）的智能体——它们共享相同的架构和训练数据，仅在奖励配置上有所不同（从基本的违规惩罚到连续的临近度惩罚）——我们分析了来自Waymo开放运动数据集的50个真实场景中的交叉注意力分配。一个核心方法论发现是，跨回合的时间步长简单池化会严重低估注意力-风险关系；使用Fisher z变换聚合的回合内相关性才是合适的统计量，并揭示了碰撞风险与智能体定向注意力之间存在稳健的正相关关系。基于这一验证过的研究方法，我们展示了两种由奖励调节的效应：使用导航奖励训练的智能体对GPS路径标记的注意力分配比使用额外临近惩罚训练的智能体高出2.0倍，比没有导航激励的智能体高出4.7倍——这表明奖励内容直接决定了编码器优先处理哪些场景元素；同时，连续的碰撞时间惩罚产生了一种“学习到的警觉先验”——即在无碰撞阶段保持持续升高的基线智能体监控水平。在若干场景中，完全奖励模型与最小奖励模型呈现出完全相反的注意力-风险相关方向，这表明奖励设计不仅可以调节注意力策略的强度，还可以从性质上逆转其方向。这些结果表明，注意力分析是一种实用的诊断工具，可用于验证奖励函数是否在安全关键型强化学习系统中产生了预期的表征行为。

title: UniTeD: Unified Temporal Diffusion for Joint Perception and Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for multi-modal planning in end-to-end autonomous driving. However, most existing methods confine diffusion to the planning module, conditioning on fixed outputs from separate discriminative perception networks. This decoupled design propagates perception errors to the planner, increasing optimization difficulty and reducing robustness. To overcome these limitations, we propose UniTeD, a Unified Temporal Diffusion framework that jointly models perception and planning through iterative denoising in a shared generative space. By enabling bidirectional information exchange, the framework facilitates mutual refinement between tasks and improves robustness via noise-conditioned multi-task training. We further extend this unified diffusion paradigm to a streaming setting by incorporating temporal context. A Temporal Transition Module (TTM) is introduced to resolve the noise-level mismatch between historical and current frames. In addition, we propose an Anchor Refresh Strategy (ARS) to alleviate the training-inference distribution shift commonly observed in sparse diffusion-based end-to-end driving frameworks. Without bells and whistles, UniTeD achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, surpassing both recent discriminative end-to-end methods and diffusion-based planning approaches.
tldr: UniTeD introduces a unified diffusion framework that jointly models perception and planning in autonomous driving through iterative denoising and temporal context, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: UniTeD 提出了一种统一的扩散框架，通过迭代去噪和时间上下文联合建模自动驾驶中的感知和规划，实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 扩散模型在端到端自动驾驶的多模态规划中展现出强大潜力。然而，现有方法大多将扩散过程局限于规划模块，并以独立的判别式感知网络输出的固定结果作为条件。这种解耦设计会将感知误差传播至规划器，增加优化难度并降低鲁棒性。为克服这些局限，我们提出UniTeD——一种统一时序扩散框架，通过共享生成空间中的迭代去噪过程，联合建模感知与规划。该框架通过启用双向信息交换，促进任务间的相互优化，并借助噪声条件多任务训练提升鲁棒性。我们进一步将这一统一扩散范式扩展至流式场景，通过引入时序上下文实现。为此提出时序过渡模块（TTM），以解决历史帧与当前帧之间的噪声级失配问题。此外，我们提出锚点刷新策略（ARS），缓解基于稀疏扩散的端到端驾驶框架中常见的训练-推理分布偏移。无需复杂设计，UniTeD在多个基准测试中均达到最先进性能，超越了近期判别式端到端方法与基于扩散的规划方法。

title: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
summary:
Autoregressive video diffusion with causal diffusion transformers has emerged as a major paradigm for real-time streaming video generation and action-conditioned interactive world models. In this work, we extend rCM, an advanced diffusion distillation framework, to autoregressive video diffusion. The core philosophy of rCM lies in the complementarity between forward and reverse divergences, represented by consistency models (CMs) and distribution matching distillation (DMD), respectively, in diffusion distillation. This philosophy naturally carries over to the autoregressive setting, where teacher-forcing (TF) provides an offline, forward-divergence causal training paradigm, while self-forcing (SF) corresponds to an on-policy, reverse-divergence refinement.
  Our contributions are: (1) through extensive experiments, we show that teacher-forcing CM is currently the best complement to self-forcing DMD as an initialization strategy (2) we present the first implementation of teacher-forcing-based continuous-time CMs (e.g., sCM/MeanFlow) for autoregressive video diffusion, enabled by our custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel, achieving 10$\times$ faster convergence compared to discrete-time CMs (dCMs) (3) we introduce Causal-rCM, a leading, unified, and scalable algorithm-infrastructure open recipe for diffusion distillation and causal training (4) we achieve state-of-the-art streaming video generation performance in both frame-wise and chunk-wise settings, using only synthetic data for training.
  Notably, our distilled 2-step causal Wan2.1-1.3B model achieves a VBench-T2V score of 84.63 with only 1 or 2 sampling steps. We further apply Causal-rCM to Cosmos 3, an advanced omnimodal world foundation model for physical AI with action-conditioned generation capability, enabling an interactive world model.
tldr: This paper introduces Causal-rCM, a unified recipe for autoregressive diffusion distillation that combines teacher-forcing and self-forcing to achieve state-of-the-art streaming video generation and action-conditioned interactive world models, with applications to a physical AI world model (Cosmos 3).
tldr_zh: 本文提出Causal-rCM，一种统一的自回归扩散蒸馏方法，结合教师强制与自我强制，在流式视频生成和动作条件交互式世界模型上达到最先进水平，并应用于物理AI世界模型Cosmos 3。
summary_zh:
自回归视频扩散结合因果扩散变换器，已成为实时流式视频生成及动作条件交互式世界模型的主要范式。本研究将先进扩散蒸馏框架rCM扩展至自回归视频扩散领域。rCM的核心哲学在于扩散蒸馏过程中前向散度与反向散度的互补性——分别由一致性模型（CM）与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）表征。该哲学自然延伸至自回归场景：教师强制（TF）提供离线式前向散度因果训练范式，而自强制（SF）则对应在线式反向散度精炼策略。

我们的贡献包括：（1）通过大量实验证明，教师强制一致性模型作为初始化策略，与自强制分布匹配蒸馏构成当前最佳互补方案；（2）首次实现基于教师强制的连续时间一致性模型（如sCM/MeanFlow）用于自回归视频扩散，通过自定义掩码FlashAttention-2 JVP核实现，相较离散时间一致性模型（dCM）收敛速度提升10倍；（3）提出Causal-rCM这一领先、统一且可扩展的算法-基础设施开源方案，用于扩散蒸馏与因果训练；（4）在逐帧与逐块两种设置下，仅使用合成训练数据即达到流式视频生成的最优性能。

值得注意的是，我们蒸馏后的两步因果Wan2.1-1.3B模型仅需1-2步采样，即可实现84.63的VBench-T2V评分。我们进一步将Causal-rCM应用于Cosmos 3——一个具备动作条件生成能力的先进全模态物理AI世界基础模型，从而构建交互式世界模型。

title: Fast LeWorldModel
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), including recent LeWorldModel (LeWM), have become a promising foundation for reconstruction-free visual world models. For visual planning, however, LeWM evaluates candidate action sequences by repeatedly applying a local one-step latent transition model. This autoregressive rollout makes planning computationally expensive and exposes the predicted trajectory to accumulated latent errors as the horizon grows. We propose Fast LeWorldModel (Fast-LeWM), a fast latent world model that replaces repeated local rollout with action-prefix prediction. Given the current latent and a candidate action sequence, Fast-LeWM encodes its prefixes and predicts the future latents reached after executing those prefixes in parallel. By making action prefixes the basic prediction unit, Fast-LeWM directly models action effects accumulated to different extents over multiple horizons. This prefix-level supervision forces the model to learn how states continuously evolve under different action prefixes, rather than only fitting one-step state transitions. During planning, the predictor can use the last prefix token from the encoded action sequence to evaluate the corresponding future latent without explicitly rolling through each intermediate imagined state.
